subject: biology
title: Ecosystems & Niches Adventure
welcome_lead: Today you'll define populations, communities and ecosystems, and explore the niche concept.
meta_desc: A-Level Biology Ecology — populations vs communities vs ecosystems, niche, abiotic and biotic factors.
final_note: You learned that a population is members of one species in an area, a community is all populations, an ecosystem includes abiotic factors, and a niche is a species' unique role.

concepts.def: All members of one species in a given area at a given time
All the populations living and interacting in an area
Community + abiotic environment, with energy flow and nutrient cycles
An organism's role — how it interacts with biotic and abiotic factors
Two species cannot share an identical niche indefinitely

walkthroughs.body_html:
Ecology nests scales:

Individual → population → community → ecosystem → biome → biosphere

- Population: all rabbits in one wood
- Community: rabbits + foxes + grasses + bacteria
- Ecosystem: community + soil, light, water, temperature
- Biome: e.g. tundra, temperate forest, desert

An ecosystem is shaped by two kinds of factor.

Abiotic (non-living):
- temperature, light, water, pH, soil nutrients, oxygen

Biotic (living):
- predation, competition, disease, food availability, mutualism

Both can be density-dependent (e.g. disease) or density-independent (e.g. drought).

A species' niche is its full role — when active, what it eats, what eats it, its temperature range, where it nests.

Competitive exclusion principle: if two species share the same niche, one will outcompete and displace the other.

Real coexistence usually means slightly different niches — like blue tits and great tits feeding at different parts of the same tree.

mcqs.q: Which term refers to all populations of different species living together in one area?

numericals.q: An ecosystem contains 200 rabbits, 50 foxes and 20 oak trees. How many populations are present (assuming each species counts as one)?

free_texts.q: What name is given to the unique role and position a species occupies in its ecosystem? One word.
free_texts.hint: No two species can share the same one indefinitely
